objective: Prove an integrated research-iterate mission can survive deliberate worker ownership loss, persistent-session loss, and orchestrator process loss by reconstructing execution solely from durable typed state, while fencing stale generations and requiring no manual state reconstruction.
invariant: Conversation/session/process memory is a replaceable cache. Durable typed state, provenance, generation fencing, and validator evidence remain authoritative.

phases.name: deterministic recovery canary
fault_injection: recover active process generation while an operator action is locally prepared
fence the bound persistent Instant session generation
attempt a late result from the retired generation
required_proofs: session generation advances and requires replacement
late old candidate is rejected with zero durable mutation
new coordinator rehydrates process/session/action state from durable store
replacement packet is deterministically recompiled with new process/session generations
a second fresh coordinator observes COMPLETED state
no chat transcript is persisted in the durable graph

phases.name: PostgreSQL restart canary
phases.objective: Repeat the same recovery sequence across fresh PostgreSQL-backed application instances so recovery is proven across process boundaries rather than only object replacement.

phases.name: real Instant recovery mission
phases.objective: Inject real managed-worker/session/process loss during a research-iterate mission, replace the session, reject stale worker output, rehydrate Supervisor state, and complete fan-in/synthesis without manual state relay.

authority_boundaries.live_attempt: requires separately reviewed one-shot live authority
